question.problem:
An inner product on $V = \mathbb{R}^3$ is given by $\langle \mathbf{x}, \mathbf{y} \rangle =  3 x_1 y_1 + x_2 y_2 + 7 x_3 y_3.$ Find $\langle \mathbf{x}, \mathbf{y} \rangle,$ if
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/differential/14149067/assets/56b28e7e25e6868a632fdad8a5441816fe0c49268f60b80ac5f8e973abb75b96.svg)
question.worked_solution:
Computing the inner product according to the definition, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}⟨x,y⟩ & =3{x}_{1}{y}_{1}+{x}_{2}{y}_{2}+7{x}_{3}{y}_{3} \\  & =3\cdot 1\cdot (-3)+(-2)\cdot 1+7\cdot 0\cdot 5 \\  & =-9-2+0 \\  & =-11.\end{aligned}
$$
